breaking_changes: MemoryJobResponse gains feedback_id, candidate_ids, disposition, error_code, and retryable; the old error field is removed and the stage enum expands to the G2 stages
non_breaking_changes: new REST bodies for resolve, memory list, and memory detail
new memory error codes and memory job error codes

scope.pipeline: feedback/edit-diff -> MemoryJob -> durability + category -> 0..3 candidate MemoryCards -> real evidence -> resolve (accept/edit_accept/reject/one_shot)
scope.provider_mode: MOCK_MODE=true deterministic baseline; real provider unverified without LLM_API_KEY

id_format.rule: each prefix is followed by a 26-character uppercase Crockford Base32 ULID

memory_job_state_machine.status: pending -> running -> completed | failed; failed -> pending only via explicit retry
memory_job_state_machine.job_retry_rule: only the owner's failed job is retryable; same idempotency key + body replays, different body returns 409, pending/running/completed are not re-enqueued

rule.rule: must/forbid maps to constraint; reusable steps map to procedure; the server decides

one_shot.rule: no long-term card; episode disposition saved

no_memory.rule: no card when evidence is missing or not reusable

memory_card_admission_invariants.after_accept_or_edit_accept: immutable v1 created, confidence set to user-confirmed value, status=active atomically

read_api.owner_isolation: list/detail/job/candidate/resolve all 404 for cross-owner or missing
read_api.no_body_in_events: event_log and SSE never carry feedback, rule, diff, evidence, or model body text

new_endpoints.rule: only the owner's failed job; same key+body replays, different body 409
accept/edit_accept/reject/one_shot; re-runs admission guard for accept/edit_accept
owner-isolated candidate/active/rejected list with cursor pagination
owner-isolated card projection, evidence drawer data, and version metadata

new_http_error_codes.MEMORY_NOT_FOUND: single 404 for missing or cross-owner memory candidate, job retry, or detail
new_http_error_codes.MEMORY_ALREADY_RESOLVED: 409 when an already-resolved card is resolved again with a new idempotency key
new_http_error_codes.MEMORY_JOB_NOT_RETRYABLE: 409 when a pending/running/completed job is retried

http_error_mapping.401: SESSION_REQUIRED when cookie is missing, expired, revoked, or tampered
http_error_mapping.404: MEMORY_NOT_FOUND for memory candidate/job/detail; TASK_NOT_FOUND for tasks; all cross-owner access 404
http_error_mapping.422: VALIDATION_ERROR or FEEDBACK_NO_CHANGES; resolve requests rejecting kind/owner/status or carrying a patch on a non-edit action

frontend_contract_note: frontend types, parser, and Mock fixtures must derive from these schemas; neither side invents a second spelling
